name: Wingspan

categories.label: Birds
categories.help: Total of the point values printed on every bird in your three habitats.

categories.label: Bonus cards
categories.help: Points from your bonus cards, using the tier each card reaches.

categories.label: Round goals
categories.help: Points from the four end-of-round goals, by your ranking in each.

categories.label: Eggs
categories.help: One point for each egg sitting on your birds.

categories.label: Cached food
categories.help: One point for each food token stored on your birds.

categories.label: Tucked cards
categories.help: One point for each card tucked under your birds.

categories.label: Food left over
categories.help: Unused food tokens still in your supply; the most wins a tie.

notes: Base game only; expansion scoring such as nectar is out of scope. Read from a university mirror of the publisher PDF; Stonemaier's Rulepop agrees on scoring and the tie-break.
